title: FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’
description: FIFA has disclosed that it was the victim of a cyberattack in which hackers accessed a limited set of personal and business information. The organization has not specified when the attack occurred or the exact nature of the compromised data. A hacking group named Handsome Boy Hacking Club claimed responsibility by posting screenshots and later referencing a leak of over 12 gigabytes of internal documents. FIFA is cooperating with law enforcement authorities and condemns the unauthorized acquisition and publication of personal data as a serious violation of privacy.
